description:
A YouTube playlist by URL or ID: title, description, owner channel, video and view counts, plus its videos (max 100) with views, publish time and duration.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `id`.
Returns: playlist_id (string), title (string), description (string), channel (object, nullable), video_count (integer, nullable), video_count_text (string, nullable), view_count (integer, nullable), view_count_text (string, nullable), thumbnail_url (string, nullable), url (string), videos_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean), videos (array<object>).

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return. Example: 10

url.description: Playlist URL or any YouTube link with a list= parameter (a bare playlist ID also works). Example: "https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLOzDu-MXXLlj7croDcwz33c-a5rpNEBNe"

name: youtube_playlist
title: YouTube playlist
